Sam (CS): Morning — Vanguard reserved pool onboarding tomorrow 9am PT. Final run-through: quota allocations, autoscale thresholds, load curve bakeout. Can we confirm who's owning the E2E?
Aisha (CS): I'll own customer comms and validation steps. @Liam can you own autoscale knobs? @Rosa to run infra soak?
Liam (Eng): I can. Quick Q: target concurrency profile is bursts up to 900 qps, steady 250 qps, right?
Sam (CS): yep those numbers. Also need per-model token limits enforced, policy: 10k context per request cap.
Rosa (SRE): I'll spin up the shadow pool and run soak. ETA 1.5h. Also need the load scripts — @Jae any changes from last run?
Jae (ProdEng): Updated the load curve script. Use loadbot profile 'vanguard_bakeout_v3'. Command: ```loadbot run --profile vanguard_bakeout_v3 --duration 30m --steps "ramp:10m:250->900,hold:15m,fall:5m"```
Rosa (SRE): perfect. I'll run that in eu-west-1 staging first.
Liam (Eng): Autoscale settings I suggest: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=40, scale_up_policy = cpu>65% for 60s or qps_per_replica>220, scale_down_cooldown=180s. Anyone object?
Aisha (CS): sounds OK but we need a safety cap for cost: emergency-fallback: route to hosted fallback when total_replicas>32 and latency > 800ms.
Sam (CS): add fallback to runbook and escalation to ops if fallback triggered.
Jae (ProdEng): noted. Also watch KV cache warmup: first 5 minutes will be noisy. Add a priming phase in script: ```--prime 10k:prefixes.txt```
Rosa (SRE): I'll include priming. Also will collect perf histograms. Post the run we'll analyze p50/p95/p99 for generate and embed paths.
load-bot: run scheduled: 1736009000, profile vanguard_bakeout_v3, duration 30m — started in staging eu-west-1
Aisha (CS): great — after staging success, we'll run in us-west-2 with shadow external traffic. Sam, can you own the customer readiness checklist?
Sam (CS): on it. checklist: quota applied, KMS keys validated, billing tags set, onboarding docs emailed, runbook links. I'll post the checklist here once done.
Liam (Eng): one more — if we hit OOM on quantized variant, auto-fallback to non-quantized with 10% lower throughput but higher mem. I'll add a route rule.
Rosa (SRE): noted. Any known risk windows? customer expected global ramp at T+6h post-cutover.
Aisha (CS): renewal risk: if we miss latency SLA in first 24h, customer flags account. Let's aim for p95 < 350ms.
Jae (ProdEng): will watch. After bakeout, ping me and I'll run a quick regression eval against customer prompt set.
Sam (CS): timeline: staging (now) -> us-west shadow (tomorrow 02:00 PT) -> cutover window 09:00 PT. Ops handoff in 30m call. :thumbsup:
Rosa (SRE): starting staging run now. will post logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/abc123 (temp link)
Aisha (CS): adding final enablement: 30m knowledge share for customer success and devs at 08:00 PT.
load-bot: staging run complete — errors: 12 500s in gen path during prime at t=5m. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/run/1736009000/errors
Rosa (SRE): saw that, investigating — looks like cold-start throttling with TPU driver spike. Bumping pre-warm threads from 2 -> 6.
Liam (Eng): pushing config: prewarm_threads=6, kv_cache_prefetch=true. Redeploying variant.
Rosa (SRE): re-running quick 10m smoke.
load-bot: smoke run complete — no 5xxs. proceeding to full bakeout in us-west-2 at scheduled time.
Aisha (CS): thanks team. Postmortem/notes: capture steps, cost delta, and customer sentiment. Sam will collate for CSM.
Sam (CS): will do. tagging retention: add perf snapshots to Redwood Console route: /vanguard/benchmarks/1736007890
Jae (ProdEng): after cutover, I'll monitor memory churn for 2 hours and leave a playback of request traces.
Rosa (SRE): all set from infra side. reassigning incident role to @oncall for cutover window.
Sam (CS): perfect. closing thread until staging results posted.
